verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no export feature for getting all of a user's data out of Mastra in open formats. The closest items are developer building blocks: `toAISdkMessages()` converts stored messages to AI SDK-compatible formats, and Apache 2.0 self-hosting means data can sit in the user's own infrastructure. Neither is a first-party bulk-export or exit capability, so neither earns credit under the partial-credit rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
